notes.title: v1.1.0.9.5 Update
notes.content:
Endless Mode Stage Configuration Adjustments
1.New Boss will appear at least once as a hidden third boss within the first 30 waves.
2.New Boss will appear at least once as a regular boss between waves 30–50.
3.Existing Bosses now have enhanced versions (marked with ★), appearing in Endless Mode with increased HP, attack power, and movement speed.

Balance Adjustments
1.If coin drops in a single wave exceed 2000, the drop rate will gradually decrease.
2.When movement speed exceeds 100%, the effective value will gradually be reduced.
3.The minimum value for effect size settings is now 0.7.
4.Some Meditations and Equipment have increased possession limits.
5.Power of Flame and Power of Voodoo have been strengthened.

notes.title: v1.1.0.8 Update
notes.content:
1.Endless Mode balance adjustments.
2.Defense damage reduction rebalanced.
3.Monster bullet and magic damage rebalanced.
4.Improved monster death splitting behavior.
5.Bosses now have 1.5 seconds of invincibility upon appearance.
6.Added tip messages.
7.Fixed a bug where Stage 9 was not unlocked after updating.
8.Weapon balance adjusted: Icewind Hammer and Whirlwind Axe.

notes.title: Summer Sale & New Update Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]
[b]Rhythm Witch: Beat Death[/b] has joined the Steam Summer Sale — now [b]10% OFF[/b]!
At the same time, a brand-new chapter [b]"Tower of Eternity"[/b] is now live![/p][p]Take on the all-new stage [b]Tower of Eternity[/b], and once you reach the 20th floor, you'll unlock [b]Endless Mode[/b] — a thrilling, non-stop rhythm combat experience![/p][p]Battle against [b]7 powerful new bosses[/b], including:
🌕 Crimson Wolf Fenrir
🛡️ Animated Armor
👁️ Greater Fiend Eye
🐉 Golden Dragon
👹 Demonplate
🔥 And the ultimate foe — the [b]Inferno Jester Mage[/b]![/p][p]Prove you're the true master of rhythm![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002866/91d66b163a54f42fd8f7d14fb7c0de757c5a9385.png"][/img][/p][p]
Below are the full update and balance details:

New Features[/p][p]1.Unlocked Level 9: Tower of Eternity.[/p][p]2.Unlocked Endless Mode. Enter Endless Mode after reaching Wav 20 or higher in Level 9. In Endless Mode, enemy HP increases significantly every 10 floors.[/p][p]3.Added 16 new Achievements.[/p][p]4.Added 8 new pieces of Equipment.[/p][p]5.New Weapons added: Ricochet Thunder Orb, Greatsword.[/p][p]6.New Meditations added: Arcane Flash, Sacred Wings.[/p][p]7.7 new Bosses added.[/p][p]8.New Streamer Safe Mode added.[/p][p][/p][p]Dynamic Difficulty Mechanic[/p][p]1.If the player’s level is too low, enemy HP will be reduced accordingly.[/p][p]2.After Wave 10, if the player’s level is too high, enemy HP will be increased accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p]Optimization[/p][p]1.Optimized performance for enemy death splitting.[/p][p]2.Adjusted vertical movement speed to compensate for slower motion caused by perspective distortion.[/p][p]3.Added statistics for bonus damage per second (including bullet splitting and attribute damage).

Bug Fixes[/p][p]1.Fixed a bug where refresh counts reset to 0 when reloading the game.[/p][p]2.Fixed an issue where attack range affected the rotation radius of Guardian Skills.[/p][p][/p][p]Balance Adjustments — System[/p][p]1.In Auto Mode, the attack multiplier penalty when taking damage is adjusted from -3 to -1.5.[/p][p]2.Luck now caps the maximum drop rate of coins and items at 80%.[/p][p]3.Reduced the actual bonus effect of ATK Radius.[/p][p]4.In Frenzy mode, efficiency of dispersed Rhythm Chests and Magic Circles increased by 20%.[/p][p]5.When a Boss is present, the drop rate of coins and items is increased.[/p][p]6.HP Regen effect increased by approximately 50%.[/p][p]7.Beastmaster: Damage reduction from the Defense attribute increased by 30%.

Balance Adjustments — Weapons & Abilities[/p][p]1.Buffed: Holy Laser, Thunderstorm, Arcana Strike, Earth Spikes, Wind Blade, Scatter Bow, Insectomancy, and all melee weapons.[/p][p]2.Guardian Inferno: Rotation radius increased by 33%.[/p][p]3.Shuriken and Whirlwind Axe: Number of hits reduced.[/p][p]4.Meditate - Power of Flame strengthened.[/p][p]5.Meditate - Power of Thunder and Power of Voodoo weakened.[/p][p]6.Meditate - Strength, Magic, and HP Regen strengthened.[/p][p]7.Meditate - Sacred Wings and Arcane Flash: Functions and balance adjusted. [/p][p][/p][p]Balance Adjustments — Runes & Abilities[/p][p]1.Rune \[Frenzy Regen]: Effect increased.[/p][p]2.Rune \[Campfire]: Effect increased, boosting Heart drop rate.
[/p]

notes.title: v1.0.10.2 Update – Mac version now available
notes.content:
New Features:
Added Mac version support.

notes.title: v1.0.10.1 Update
notes.content:
New Features:
1. Added a “Max Effect Size” setting when “Effect changes with ATK Radius” is enabled.
(Default value is x1.5. Setting it to x1 can significantly reduce overly flashy effects caused by increased attack range.)

Optimizations:
1.Improved monster spawn positions and counts in horizontal-style stages.
2.Fixed: When purchasing a weapon that is placed in the first slot of the backup bag, the selected weapon could not be merged or sold.
3.Fixed: The ATK Radius bonus shown on weapons was lower than the actual effect.
(Corrected a calculation error and adjusted the ATK Radius bonus so the actual effect closely matches the previous balance.)
4.Fixed display issues on 1440x900 resolution screens.
5.Equipment Merchant and Blacksmith will now always appear in Wave 9.

notes.title: v1.0.9.1 Update
notes.content:
New Features:
1.Introduced 3 new equipment items.
2. Starting from Wave 8, the Equipment Shop has a chance to offer Epic-grade equipment.

Optimizations:
1.Added a re-check system for Steam achievements in case they fail to unlock due to unexpected issues.
2.Safeguard: The Beat key and other controls can no longer be assigned to the same button.
3.A 1.5-second delay is added before each wave starts to better synchronize with the music.
4.Controller support expanded to include PS4 and Switch Pro controllers.
5.The Equipment Shop now displays a “Missing Seals for the Weapon” hint.

Balance Adjustments:
4.In Shooting Mode, combo multiplier is no longer reduced for early beats during Fever.
2.Reload time in Shooting Mode is now faster and scales with the song's BPM.
3.Reload sound effect in Shooting Mode has been adjusted.
4.Tracking projectiles from some bosses now move slower.
5.Faith-type weapons and Crimson Lightning have been strengthened.

notes.title: v1.0.8.1 Update
notes.content:
Optimizations:
1.When unlocking equipment and weapons through achievements, the corresponding entries in the Gallery will now be unlocked immediately.
2.Hell Mode has been adjusted to have 3 difficulty levels. The original version now corresponds to Level 3.

notes.title: v1.0.7.3 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
1.Fixed a bug where the boss HP UI would not disappear after a battle ended when two bosses appeared.
2.Fixed an issue where musical notes from treasure chests and magic circles would fly out of the scene.

Balance Adjustments:
1.Significantly reduced the number of obstacles in the environment (trees, small rocks, tombstones) — they no longer block player movement.
2.Reduced the number of traps in the environment and decreased trap damage (Trial difficulty remains unchanged).
3.Lowered the HP of monsters in the first 3 waves.
4.Reduced the difficulty of Stages 7 and 8.

notes.title: v1.0.6Update
notes.content:
1.Added a toggle option for hit effect display.
2.Fixed missing sound effects when hitting on beat.
3.When customizing controls, buttons without icons will now display text labels instead.
4.Optimized display issues for 3340x1140 resolution.
5.Optimized display issues for 2560x1440 resolution.
6.Modified unlock conditions for Advanced and Frenzy Rhythm modes:
Winning a run will unlock both modes.
Failing a run will also unlock both modes, provided Auto Mode has already been unlocked.

notes.title: v1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
1.Fixed issues in the Japanese translation.
2.Added detailed information for HP regeneration, including the actual recovery rate per second.
3.Corrected controller button mappings for certain gamepads.
4.Adjusted the order of some music tracks.

notes.title: ☠️ May 9th - Grand Launch - Rhythm Witch: Beat Death is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
A thrilling undead celebration that combines beats and survivor elements has finally begun. As the skeletons summoned by the Necromancer Sibel, are you ready to follow the rhythm of the music and fight against the horde of monsters in the Immortal Tower’s labyrinth?

What’s even more exciting is that multiple streamers will join this undead feast, battling side by side with you to challenge the legendary ""Immortal Tower""! Want to see who can perfectly sync to the beats and break through the levels? Log in now and join this bone-rattling magical battle!

Call your friends, come and witness the power of the skeleton army—
Head to Steam now to grab Rhythm Witch: Beat Death and feel the shocking impact of the undead rhythm!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002866/7b53f8d3fd53eb4245ab4c802f0a9af8543e9901.png[/img]

notes.title: "Rhythm Witch: Beat Death" ♬ Feel the Rhythm, Hear the Soul of Battle!
notes.content:
Today, we’re giving you a taste of the true heartbeat behind Rhythm Witch: Beat Death — the music!

With over 30 original tracks spanning a wide range of genres, the game’s soundtrack breathes life into every battle. From eerie and whimsical melodies to high-speed, pulse-pounding anthems, each tune brings its own soul to the rhythm-driven combat.

We’ve carefully selected a few of our favorite tracks for you, our fellow skeletons ☠️, to experience in advance.
🎧 Heads up: Grab your headphones and let the beats immerse you in the perfect harmony of music and battle!

After you’ve had a listen, drop us a comment and tell us:
💀 Which skeleton beat was your favorite?
🎶 What kind of tracks are you excited to hear during your adventure?

Let’s gather the power of the undead — one beat at a time!



[previewyoutube=0JOrZ0lFnwE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: ☠️ Skeleton Army – The Most Confident Lightning Mage ☠️
notes.content:
In life, he was a legendary grand sorcerer—tall, dignified, draped in a suit-like robe, with massive skeletal wings unfurled behind him.

The Elemancer fights with dazzling flair, channeling crackling lightning between his hands that strikes fear into all who see it. Proud and aloof, he often looks down on his fellow skeletons. Yet, to avoid fading away from magical exhaustion, he takes it upon himself to cook and care for Sybelle’s daily needs. Compared to the rest of the undead lost in their own fantasies, Morta is more like a sharp-tongued but dependable butler.

Morta:
"Master, you must eat. Excessive dieting would be most troubling for me."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002866/37f334e2968de87cad593489192ede699b396324.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ☠️ Skeleton Army – The Coolest Archer ☠️
notes.content:
If you spot a cloaked figure perched silently atop a distant treetop, you’re likely looking at this mysterious beastkin archer.

Emerald Shadow always strives to maintain her “cool” image—but she can’t resist seeking her master's approval. She often brings back rabbits or small monsters as trophies, proudly showing them off to earn praise. Unfortunately, fashion isn’t her strong suit, and her efforts rarely impress. This only fuels her determination to stand out, displaying an almost obsessive fighting spirit within the squad.

Ullr:
"Master! Behold my flawless archery! And look—I brought you something cute!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002866/45cc67f89678d4d92042b1d805900321a23857e6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ☠️ Skeleton Army – The Most Joyful Bard ☠️
notes.content:
Wearing a wide-brimmed straw hat and strumming a flamboyant guitar, Bard was once a wandering musician full of cheer. Even in death, now reduced to bare bones, he still radiates that same carefree spirit.

The Macabre Bard loves to improvise, channeling musical energy into dazzling critical strikes against enemies. Unfortunately, he has zero danger awareness—constantly stumbling into traps mid-battle, then chuckling as he pieces his bones back together. When Bard is deep in performance mode, even necromancers have to tolerate the noise—after all, no battlefield would be complete without the chaotic joy of this explosive skeleton jester.

Bard:
"Master! My toe bone’s stuck in a hole… Please, a little help…?"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002866/ba852ef0e137d3d4c09c4270f27c4d95b0994f55.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ☠️ Skeleton Army – The Most Loyal Warrior ☠️
notes.content:
A warrior clad in the skull of a beast, the Beastmaster excels at close-range physical combat. If you’re the type to charge headfirst into battle, this rugged frontline fighter is your ideal pick.

In life, Hum was a mercenary obsessed with physical strength. Upon death, his loyal beast companion was revived alongside him, and their souls fused into one. As a result, he now possesses an animal’s keen sense of smell and unwavering loyalty—especially to the Witch, whose orders he follows without question.
However… there is one weakness: he's extremely sensitive to strong scents. Even the faintest fragrance can throw him off balance.

Hum:
"Mistress… the scent is too strong… it’s bothering me… ah-choo!"


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002866/4e853f3a8804be02470ba4276e8debdf2a11278f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ☠️ Skeleton Army – The Most Alluring Witch ☠️
notes.content:
If you ever come across a woman in a sleek black off-shoulder gown, wearing a half-skull mask… be on high alert.

The mysterious Hexmage carries with her a cursed spellbook, said to contain pages filled with cruel and merciless incantations—each one a brand-new way to torment her unfortunate targets. Beneath her icy elegance lies a deep loathing for deceitful men. Should anyone dare harbor impure thoughts, she’ll quietly lure them in with her subtle charm… then obliterate them with overwhelming dark magic.

Indigo:
"My lovely little master, don’t go messing up your hair again."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002866/25d3e095308a6a54e898ea60a61ad353fdae2866.jpg[/img]

notes.title: First Look at the Skeleton Army of Rhythm Witch: Beat Death!
notes.content:
Hey Skeletons!
Starting today, we’ll be introducing the quirky and unique characters from Rhythm Witch: Beat Death — and who better to begin with than our adorable master herself: Sibel!

🧙 Skeleton Sorceress - Sibel (Necromancer)
She may look like a mischievous and charming young girl, but she’s actually over 700 years old!
Clad in a frilly gothic dress and always holding a floating skull, Sibel even lounges on a crescent-shaped floating moon, surrounded by semi-transparent skeleton minions.

Sibel is obsessed with bizarre and eerie beauty rituals — whether it’s necromantic magic, blood baths, or any creepy-sounding remedy, she’s willing to try it all in pursuit of eternal beauty. As for chores? That’s what her summoned skeletons are for! Sibel is far too lazy to lift a finger herself... or even take a single step, really. After all, she’s still a “young lady.”

Sibel:
"With the secret treasure of immortality… I can stay beautiful forever~"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002866/d5a6060f5ed6077cc50608b66eca626eec0e3235.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 💀 Countdown to Eternal Beauty Begins! 💀
notes.content:
Rumor has it that the "Tower of the Undying" hides a mysterious relic that grants eternal beauty.
Skeletons, the day we’ve been waiting for is almost here — the time to gather has come! ☠️
Now, strike the drums of the undead together and march for eternal beauty (maybe?)!
Are you ready for the final countdown to this undead rhythm feast?

Rhythm Witch: Beat Death launches on May 9!
